name: Sparse Voxel DAG Voxelization via Bounding Box Grid and Plane Projections
aliases: Triangle Voxelization with XY/ZX/YZ Projection Tests
definition: A voxelization algorithm that iterates over a 2D grid (XY) within a triangle's bounding box, determines the Z-range of voxels intersecting the triangle plane, and fills only those voxels that pass containment tests in the XY, ZX, and YZ projections. It uses a Morton code for indexing into a sparse voxel structure.
